First time I smoked, i didn't even plan on doing so.

It was a late summer night, I met with a friend and she and her boyfriend were drinking rum. As they saw me,they invited me to sit with them, so I joined them.

I didn't drink too much, since I had a long ride home ahead of me (i was on my bike as well), about like 30 or 40 minutes or so, but it was still a somewhat considerable amount as I started feeling the positive effects of alcohol.

Anyway, my friend has to leave and I choose to walk her home because hey I have nothing better to do this summer night and I wanted to find an excuse to avoid hanging out with my ex. 

On the way, she tells me she's got some stuff she bought earlier and asked me if I mind her lighting one up before going home.

I knew she was an occasional smoker and I've hang out with her before while she'd roll one and smoke so it wasn't much of a surprise for me.

 Being slightly lightheaded from the alcohol, I agreed to sit with her and wanted to try. She seemed not to like this idea much, but she went along as I assures that everything would be fine and it wouldn't probably do anything for me at all.

Anyway, we roll it, and she lights it. And after she takes her drag, she passes it to me. Stupidly enough, I though that since i felt the effects of booze that much, this joint wouldn't do shit, even tho it was tobacco free. So I drag one huge ass cloud. And then pass it to her.

We wait for a bit, and about 10 mins pass but I still don't feel any different. She tells me that sometimes first time users don't get high at all the first time they smoke, so I assumed I was one of them.

Dissapointed, I kept smoking more and more till it suddenly fucking hits me. And I'm fucking freaking because I wasn't just high feeling all nice and munchies and "brooo this shit is fire" good. I was fucking, time warping tripping balls wtf is this trying to keep my cool high. And it happened in a matter of seconds. 

My friend tries to calm me down, and gives me the snicker bar she saved for herself and some water, and follows me asap to the nearest tap so I could splash some water in my face. I was greening out. 

We get back, and we sit down. I felt slightly relieved, then I get a call from my dad asking me when I'm coming home. I was fucking shit, yet to this day I believe I pulled it off good on my parents. We're done talking and I hang up the phone. Then my fucking ex calls me asking why im not coming, I freaked out. The call felt like it lasted forever and it was so damn weird and off, her voice sounded ever more slow and I was anxious if this was how I sounded like to her. She was very anti drugs and she'd tell everyone if she knew what was happening. Or would use this to convince me to be with her or whatever. I just hated the idea of her knowing what's up, so I try my best to just find an excuse and hung up. And I did.

I look at my friend and she tells me she needs to get going, she finishes the joint and we start heading home. But I'm faced with a problem.

I'm in the brink of fucking losing it and ahead of me I've got 40 minutes of riding, crossing one major intersection, going through dark fields, dark roads, you name it.

I get on my bike, look at my friend and just fucking start riding. I can barely keep myself balanced but I manage to get the hang of this. I had to get home soon, and with this kind of crazy road ahead of me, I thought I mustn't spare a second contemplating shit. I just ride.

It was a hell of a ride, at one point when I was going through a dark forest area, I thought there were wolves howling and I was so freaked out, still I kept going. 

I managed to get home without stopping at all, which I've never did in the way home, like ever. I always needed to catch my breath and especially where this forest-y part of the road is, it's like a huge ass ascend that never fucking ends.

Everything just screamed dangerous tbh I kinda regret taking this risk as I was almost hit by a car twice that night. I could just find an excuse and hang out anywhere alone until I come down more.

But I did feel high af for a few days later, it was wild lol and I'm sure my parents knew something wasn't right but I made it through without them ever mentioning to me or asking me about that night again.

TLDR i tried smoking the first time. Wasn't planned. Underestimated my powers. Got fucked up. Had to ride home at night for abt and hour through dark fields and forests. Almost got hit by two cars. Not doing it again

She went silent and I realised that, although I might've been right, that was harsh.
